resetCommandDone: Infinitary is reset. It opens on the welcome screen next time.
resetCommandHelp: Deletes everything Infinitary keeps here, once you confirm it is you.
resetCommandKept: You did not confirm, so nothing was reset.
resetCommandNoConfirmation: This computer cannot confirm it is you here, so nothing was reset. Use Reset Infinitary in Settings → General, or on the screen Infinitary shows when it cannot open.
resetCommandRunning: Infinitary is open on this computer, so nothing was reset. Use Reset Infinitary in Settings → General, or quit Infinitary and run this again.
resetConfirmReasonBoth: Reset Infinitary on {home} and this computer.
resetConfirmReasonBothMac: reset Infinitary on {home} and this computer
resetCouldNotStartMessage: It stopped twice before it finished starting. Your saved work has not been changed.
resetCouldNotStartNext: Try again, or reset Infinitary to start over as if just installed.
resetHeldDetail: Another program is using Infinitary's folder. Close it, then try again.
resetHeldMessage: Infinitary could not finish its reset
resetKeysAsk: Reset every key to the {preset} preset's?
resetKeysDetail: Every shortcut you changed in Keyboard settings goes back to the one the {preset} preset gives it.
resetRunEnded: Infinitary here was reset, so this run ends for good, and Infinitary opens on the welcome screen next time.
resetScreenKeeps: Projects in your own folders keep every file and commit.
